name: ziran-language
description: Ziran language support, generated code preview for every target, and Kryon project preview

ziran.command.description: Path to the ziran command used to check files, generate code, and inspect .zir files. Empty uses a Ziran checkout above the file or beside the workspace, then ~/.local/bin/ziran, then PATH.

enumDescriptions: Generated C, the assembly the C compiler emits for it, and the executable
Generated Go, Go's own (Plan 9) assembly, and the executable
Legacy setting alias for Native; ZX is now a stage within Native, not a separate target
Direct native pipeline: source, checked ZIR, LIR, optimized ZX, target assembly and ELF

ziran.previewTargets.description: Targets the Run pane builds and inspects. Each shows its source, assembly and binary in tabs; the pane's checkboxes update this setting.

ziran.packagePaths.markdownDescription: Package checkouts for `#import "NAME/module"` in files outside a Ziran project, such as `{ "kryon": "../kryon" }`. Each becomes `--module-path NAME=DIR` for its module roots. Unlisted packages are found as `NAME/` or `ORG/NAME/` beside the file, its parent folders or an open folder.

ziran.modulePaths.description: Additional module directories, relative to a workspace folder or absolute. Workspace modules and a sibling Ziran std directory are found automatically.

ziran.kryonCommand.description: Path to the kryon launcher for project previews. Empty uses ~/.local/bin/kryon when present, then PATH.

ziran.previewProfile.description: Canvas profile for the interactive Kryon preview. Empty selects portable_web, then web, then another canvas profile.
